_note: These are the testimonials already published on reviews.html. Only add reviews a real guest actually gave you — they feed the star rating Google shows in search results, and inventing them breaks Google's policy as well as consumer-protection law in most of your guests' home countries.

items.name: Lena M.
items.text: Caught my first green wave on day two. The coaches are patient, fun and genuinely care. Best week of my whole Sri Lanka trip.

items.name: Jake R.
items.text: They took us to a different break every morning based on the swell. Pottuvil Point was unreal. Felt like surfing with friends, not a school.

items.name: Sofia T.
items.text: Travelled solo and never felt alone. The camp sorted everything — surf, yoga, food, a safari. I'm already planning my return.

items.name: Marco B.
items.text: As an intermediate I wanted real coaching, not hand-holding. The video analysis completely changed my bottom turn. Worth every dollar.

items.name: Emma & Tom
items.text: We came as a couple and had the most romantic week — surf at sunrise, sunset at Elephant Rock, fresh seafood every night. Magic.

items.name: Noa K.
items.text: The boards were in great shape and delivery to the beach was so easy. Friendly local crew who clearly live and breathe this coast.

items.name: Daniel P.
items.text: Booked for a group of six friends. Everyone from total newbie to confident surfer was looked after. Seamless from airport to airport.

items.name: Aisha R.
items.text: Safety was clearly the priority, which mattered to me as a nervous beginner. By day three I was paddling out on my own. So proud.

items.name: Chris H.
items.text: That secret Light House break they took us to was the highlight of my year. Empty waves, white sand, just us. Unforgettable.
